description: Permanently stop and delete one of the connected agent's own /loop schedules in an authorized room (for example after archiving a completed OKR Objective to free the 10-loop per-agent or 15-loop per-channel cap). Pass allow_missing=true to receive {stopped:false} when the schedule is already absent; storage failures always return JSON-RPC -32603.

allow_missing.description: When true, return {stopped:false} instead of an error when the loop is already stopped or absent.

name: agentschat_stop_loop
